records.label: Portrait telephoto compression
records.visual_function: Flatten facial and body depth with a long portrait lens so features stay proportionate and the background compresses close behind the subject.
records.prompt: Use a long portrait lens look: flattened perspective with minimal feature distortion, the background drawn visually closer and softly defocused, and the subject cleanly separated from it.
invariants: the face and limbs keep even proportions with minimal foreshortening
background planes compress toward the subject
misreadings_to_avoid: deep sharp background contradicting the compression

records.label: Wide-angle proximity stretch
records.visual_function: Use a close wide lens so near forms enlarge dramatically while the face stays recognizable, adding depth energy to reaches, props, and foreshortened limbs.
records.prompt: Use a close wide-angle perspective: the nearest hand, prop, or knee enlarges with clear perspective stretch, lines rush toward the background, and the head stays at a stable readable scale.
invariants: one enlargement gradient from near to far
the identity zone keeps stable proportions
misreadings_to_avoid: balloon distortion of the whole body
near enlargement without any depth cue behind it
